brief.pitch: Free preview websites for NYC local-service businesses, judged on an iPhone: one tap to call, what they do, where, a way to enquire. Honest: no invented reviews, figures, hours or licences. Static, fast, no WebGL.

route: build-site, (c) build unique, target 'other': three static HTML templates filled by atlas/modules/agency/sitetemplate.py. GetLayers is used at design time only; nothing calls it at run time.

materialized.use: reference for the shape language only: card on a field, the 28/20/14 radius ladder, a pill for every control, the label that rolls up out of its window on hover, hairlines instead of shadows. No section, spring, photograph or copy was copied; no 'preserve' layer (motion, composition) was rewritten.

trades.for: plumbers, electricians, roofers, locksmiths, painters, movers, contractors
trades.type: Archivo variable, statements (hero lines, section titles) at wdth 92 / wght 780, display (wordmark, docket) at wdth 62 / wght 800 (van-side lettering), body at wdth 100

hero.composition: cortex-hero (v3), replaced in v4 by the Lovable reference's cinematic hero: the photograph full bleed under a navy gradient, three stacked lines, the second marigold

beauty.type: Archivo variable, display at wdth 125 / wght 260 (expanded, light), body at wdth 100

food.for: restaurants, cafes, bakeries, florists, caterers, dry cleaners, tailors, shops
food.paletteId: jade-depths (a dark palette, re-dressed light on the DOM: its secondary is the panel, its pale jade the awning stripe)
food.type: Archivo variable, display at wdth 100 / wght 900 (shop sign), body at wdth 100

placed.note: 4|8 heading split over ruled rows instead of image cards: there are no photographs to put in a triptych
short prompt, fields on hairlines, one pill; the form only exists when the client has a form service
narrow heading beside a ruled accordion (details/summary, no script)
closing line and pill, weighted columns, meta bar

fonts: getlayers_fonts was consulted; none of its fifteen has a width axis and each would be a new download. Archivo variable (OFL, already self-hosted for the Mapfront landing, templates/fonts/) carries all three families through wdth 62-125, so one type system, three voices, no third-party request.
notReused: Mapfront's own teal #0f3d3e and marigold #f4b942 are not used on client sites, and ridgeline's Geist Mono uppercase labels were dropped (labels are Archivo, sentence case).
previewLinks: Only links GetLayers itself returned are recorded: ridgeline (Style and template), and the artist and baseline templates the artist-hero and baseline-hero compositions were seeded from. Compositions and palette cards carry no preview link, so cortex-hero, dringle-palette and jade-depths have none here. The interaction pass adds only links GetLayers returned for the cards it used: brewns, hero-mirror-hall and aerra.
notes: One Style for the whole system; each family is a re-tint (paletteId), its own hero composition and its own GetLayers Background, so the three read as one studio's work without looking alike. The loop is desktop-only; a phone gets the poster.

interaction.ask: the owner, from the phone review: "design it better with buttons, reservations if it's a restaurant or booking system ... make GetLayers use interactive website design for all the clients".
interaction.route: enhance-project (mode 5) on the committed build: read the checked-in templates first, then add motion and interaction. Same Style (ridgeline-style), same palettes, same Archivo type; nothing materialized, nothing called at run time.
interaction.principle: One moment per family, and each one answers the visitor's own input inside the booking flow; nothing ambient, no loader. Everything else is the controls' own state changes (hover, focus-visible, active, disabled, loading, error, done).

trades.name: the work order
trades.what: The booking sheet opens on a navy docket with a perforated edge. Picking a job, typing the address and choosing a day and time of day prints each line onto it; sending stamps it ("Sending" live, "Not sent" in a preview).

references.took: a receipt built in HTML/CSS that fills as you act, never an image; not its printer, scene or code

beauty.name: the mirror
beauty.what: The sheet opens under the arched mirror from the hero. The treatment and time you pick appear in it, and a skewed sheen crosses the glass on each change; sending stamps it. Each treatment row has its own Book pill that opens the sheet with that treatment chosen.

references.took: a reflective surface that answers the visitor's movement; not its WebGL floor
its CTA hover's skewed sheen sweeping the width (~700ms), as the mirror's sheen (950ms)

food.name: the table
food.what: The sheet opens under the awning from the hero, which unrolls. The party-size stepper lays a place at a round table for each guest (facing pairs first, on a small overshoot spring); the table size, day and time read back on the awning. Bakeries, florists, caterers, tailors and other shops get the awning and read-back without the table.

motionRules: revealChoreography: text lands opaque early in its curve and de-blurs (the read-back lines: opaque at 30%, blur 2px to 0, 460ms)
revealChoreography: reduced motion reaches everything; every animation and transition drops to 1ms, the sheen is removed, and the script starts no motion of its own
combinationRules: motionEnergy is a page budget; the brief stays still/subtle, so the moments are user-triggered and short (200-950ms)

compositionsConsulted.use: the booking form's rhythm: short prompt, fields, one full-width pill
considered, not used: an inline capsule holds two fields, a booking needs five or six

simplified: No loader or curtain (revealChoreography's default): it gates LCP on a phone, and a local business page is visited once by someone who wants to book or call.
No scene, gradient or background: the brief is flat and mobile-first, and the sheet already carries the moment. getlayers_scene_lab and materialize were not used.
No GetLayers font: Archivo variable stays the one self-hosted family.
interaction.sheet: A native <dialog>: a bottom sheet under 40rem, a centred panel above. The #book section holds the same form in the page, so without a script the button still scrolls to it.

media.ask: the owner, from the desktop review: "very poor design -- make sure it's a frontend marketing website for each one".
media.route: wire-video (mode 4) + browse-pull (mode 3) on the committed build, same Style (ridgeline-style): one GetLayers Background per family behind the hero, materialized with styleId ridgeline-style and downloaded from the signed links (never hotlinked), re-encoded for the web in templates/media/ and copied beside every page by sitemedia.copy_assets. Photographs are Unsplash, under the Unsplash License, self-hosted the same way.

trades.retired: 2026-10-01 (v4): the trades hero is the photograph itself, so the loop and its posters were removed from templates/media; the id stays here for the record

beauty.why: cool silk light in the dringle lavender, behind the arched mirror

food.why: an empty sage corner with one sunbeam: the shop wall the awning and the sign hang on

media.loading: The poster (AVIF then WebP, two widths) is what every visitor gets; the loop is attached by an inline script only on a screen at least 56rem wide that does not ask for reduced motion, and never autoplays sound. Nothing on a phone downloads the video.
media.photos: sitemedia.PHOTOS: Unsplash IDs and photographers are recorded on each entry; every alt begins 'Illustrative photo:' and nothing is captioned as the business's own team, van, premises or work.

compositionsConsulted.use: the hero: a copy column beside a tall plate, the two vertically centred
the services heading, label left and statement right, over a row of cards; here one card is the photograph
the facts strip: a shallow rail of label pairs under the hero, only facts from the lead's record
how it works: evenly pitched stations along one baseline, numbered because it is a sequence
the closing band and the footer's weighted columns and meta bar

media.notUsed: No scene, no loader, no scroll-scrubbed motion: a local business page is visited once by someone who wants to book or call, and the brief stays still/subtle.

lovable.rule: the owner: every client site's design goes frontend-design -> GetLayers -> Webild -> Lovable, and the best of each is ported into these static templates. A Lovable project is a design reference only; its React app is never deployed as a client site, and its photographs (rights unknown) are never copied -- the templates use sitemedia.PHOTOS.

trades.subject: lead 40, Hitchingham Electric Company (electrician), from the lead's own record and the honesty rules
ported: the cinematic full-bleed photo hero with a dark gradient and a three-line headline, one line in the mark colour (sitetemplate.default_lines per trade; the model's `lines` field is validated like every other)
the small numbered section labels, '01 / What we do' (sitetemplate.Numbering: the page is a sequence, and a section that is not rendered takes no number)
large statement headings with a drawn full stop in the mark colour (sitetemplate.statements, code-written, claim-checked)
the navy 'how it works' band with the numbered list on the right
the tilted street map with the borough, its neighbours, the street and a monogram pin (sitetemplate.street_map)
the two-column booking: statement and 'Prefer to talk?' on the left, the form in a white card on the right (sitebooking.section)
the 'A few things worth knowing' FAQ heading beside the ruled accordion
the marigold closing band with navy pills
the phone in words beside the booking pill in the header
notPorted: its photograph (rights unknown): sitemedia.PHOTOS, self-hosted Unsplash
the numerals on the service cards (services are not a sequence)
the arrows appended to link and button labels
its geometric sans: Archivo variable stays the one self-hosted family
trades.kept: our structure, honesty rules, pagegate, launch check, booking paths, the callme slot, every button's states, self-hosted media only, mobile light (no video on a phone, as before)
